programs.title: Anything but Gray
programs.sub_title: .... for a Duplex Overhaul on a Deadline
programs.desc: Gray, Grumpy and Chelcie transform a Charleston duplex into a cheerful single family home -- just in time for the homeowner's birthday; with purple trim, green walls and yellow cabinets, these brave homeowners embrace Gray's most colorful designs yet.

programs.title: In With the Old
programs.desc: A couple transforms a dilapidated 1830s house in Charleston, S.C., into their dream home; they restore as many original details as possible, including the plaster walls, the floors and the trademark Charleston piazzas.

programs.title: Restoring Galveston
programs.desc: Camelbacks are not common in Galveston, Texas, but the challenge is to make this one a historic head-turner; the Cordrays transform the attic into a cozy family space and build an outdoor sofa that a Gulf storm can't destroy.

programs.title: Restoring Galveston
programs.desc: Michael and Ashley turn a 1904 single-story bungalow into an adorable home with two bedrooms, two bathrooms, and garage space; a built-in banquette, nostalgic cabinet casings, and an accent wall highlight the interior design.

programs.title: Restoring Galveston
programs.desc: The Cordrays' new home gets a kid-friendly playroom with a climbing wall slide, storefront windows, a homework space with desks, a library with wallpapered shelves and a vintage sliding ladder.

programs.title: Restoring Galveston
